findings.en_sentence: Tyrannosaurus possessed short but unusually powerful forelimbs with two clawed digits relative to its large hind limbs.
findings.es_sentence: El Tyrannosaurus poseía antebrazos cortos pero inusualmente potentes con dos dedos armados de garras, en comparación con sus grandes extremidades traseras.
findings.problem: 'antebrazos' means forearms (elbow to wrist), not forelimbs; the whole limb is meant.
findings.correct: El Tyrannosaurus tenía extremidades anteriores (brazos) cortas pero inusualmente potentes para su tamaño, con dos dedos con garras, en comparación con sus grandes extremidades posteriores.

findings.en_sentence: Paleontologists Kenneth Carpenter and Matt Smith argued that Tyrannosaurus forelimbs were not useless and that the animal was not an obligate scavenger.
findings.es_sentence: Los paleontólogos Kenneth Carpenter y Matt Smith argumentaron que los antebrazos del Tyrannosaurus no eran inútiles y que el animal no era un carroñero obligado.
findings.correct: ...que las extremidades anteriores (los brazos) del Tyrannosaurus no eran inútiles...

findings.en_sentence: Tyrannosaurus possessed short but unusually powerful forelimbs with two clawed digits relative to its large hind limbs.
findings.problem: 'relative to its large hind limbs' attaches to 'two clawed digits'; the comparison is about forelimb length, and 'powerful' is 'for their size'.
findings.correct: Relative to its large hind limbs, Tyrannosaurus had short forelimbs, unusually powerful for their size, with two clawed digits.

findings.en_sentence: The largest known Tyrannosaurus skulls measure up to 1.52 meters in length.
findings.es_sentence: Los cráneos de Tyrannosaurus conocidos más grandes miden hasta 1,52 metros de longitud.
findings.problem: The 1.52 m (5 ft) figure is the 2006 MOR 008 claim; the same source says later comparisons found the longest head to be 136.5 cm (LACM 23844).
findings.correct: The longest known Tyrannosaurus skull measures about 1.37 m (136.5 cm, LACM 23844).
findings.checked_in: F025, F026 (enwiki Continued study) vs F032 (enwiki Skull)

findings.en_sentence: The Bucky specimen stood 10 feet tall and measured 35 feet long, while the Sue specimen ranged from 12.3 to 12.8 meters in length and 3.66 to 3.96 meters tall at the hips.
findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar Bucky medía 10 pies de alto y 35 pies de largo, mientras que el ejemplar Sue tenía una longitud comprendida entre 12,3 y 12,8 metros y una altura en cadera de 3,66 a 3,96 metros.
findings.problem: Feet and metres mixed in one comparison; feet are meaningless to Spanish readers.
findings.correct: Bucky: about 3 m tall and 10.7 m long (EN may keep feet in parentheses); ES: 'unos 3 m de alto y 10,7 m de largo'.

findings.en_sentence: Bucky is the first Tyrannosaurus specimen found to preserve a furcula, or wishbone.
findings.es_sentence: Bucky es el primer ejemplar de Tyrannosaurus encontrado que conserva una fúrcula, o hueso de la suerte.
findings.problem: 'hueso de la suerte' is a calque of 'wishbone'; the usual Spanish term is 'espoleta'.

findings.en_sentence: A 2017 study found that a Tyrannosaurus specimen nicknamed Wyrex preserves patches of mosaic scales on its tail, hip, and neck.
findings.es_sentence: Un estudio de 2017 encontró que un ejemplar de Tyrannosaurus apodado Wyrex conserva parches de escamas mosaico en su cola, cadera y cuello.
findings.correct: ...conserva parches de escamas en mosaico en la cola, la cadera y el cuello.

findings.en_sentence: Tyrannosaurus was likely an apex predator that preyed on hadrosaurs, juvenile ceratopsians, ankylosaurs, and possibly sauropods.
findings.es_sentence: El Tyrannosaurus fue probablemente un superdepredador que cazaba hadrosáuridos, ceratopsianos juveniles, anquilosaurios y posiblemente saurópodos.
findings.problem: Source says juvenile armored herbivores 'like ceratopsians and ankylosaurs'; 'juvenile' applies to both, not only ceratopsians.
findings.correct: ...preyed on hadrosaurs, juvenile armored herbivores such as ceratopsians and ankylosaurs, and possibly sauropods.

findings.en_sentence: Pathologies in T. rex specimens, such as a hole in the jugal of 'Wyrex' and tail trauma, are suggested as evidence of attacks by other T. rex.
findings.es_sentence: Las patologías en ejemplares de T. rex, como un agujero en el jugal de 'Wyrex' y traumas en la cola, se sugieren como evidencia de ataques de otros T. rex.
findings.problem: 'se sugieren como evidencia' is a calque of 'are suggested as evidence'.
findings.correct: ...se han propuesto como prueba de ataques de otros T. rex.

findings.en_sentence: Histological analysis revealed that the juvenile Jordan theropod was only 2 years old when it died.
findings.es_sentence: El análisis histológico reveló que el juvenil terópodo de Jordan solo tenía 2 años cuando murió.
findings.problem: Wrong word order: 'el juvenil terópodo de Jordan'.
findings.correct: El análisis histológico reveló que el terópodo de Jordan, un juvenil, solo tenía 2 años cuando murió.

findings.en_sentence: In 2022, Wiemann and colleagues used lipoxidation spectroscopy to show that Tyrannosaurus had an endothermic metabolism comparable to modern birds and higher than mammals.
findings.es_sentence: En 2022, Wiemann y sus colegas utilizaron espectroscopía de lipoxidación para demostrar que el Tyrannosaurus tenía un metabolismo endotérmico comparable al de las aves modernas y superior al de los mamíferos.
findings.problem: Presents a single, debated proxy study as proof ('show'/'demostrar'); the bird-level result is for several dinosaur genera, not a Tyrannosaurus-specific finding.
findings.correct: In 2022, Wiemann and colleagues used lipoxidation spectroscopy to argue that several dinosaurs, Tyrannosaurus among them, were endotherms with metabolic rates comparable to modern birds. (ES: 'para proponer que...')

findings.en_sentence: Tendon avulsion injuries were found only in Tyrannosaurus and Allosaurus among the theropods studied.
findings.es_sentence: Se encontraron lesiones de avulsión de tendones únicamente en Tyrannosaurus y Allosaurus entre los terópodos estudiados.
findings.problem: Refers to 'the theropods studied' without ever introducing the study.
findings.correct: A study of injuries in theropod skeletons (Rothschild and colleagues, 2001) found tendon avulsions only in Tyrannosaurus and Allosaurus.

findings.en_sentence: Daspletosaurus and Tarbosaurus are other members of the tyrannosaurine subfamily and have occasionally been synonymized with Tyrannosaurus.
findings.es_sentence: Daspletosaurus y Tarbosaurus son otros miembros de la subfamilia tiranosaurina y han sido ocasionalmente sinonimizados con Tyrannosaurus.
findings.problem: 'subfamilia tiranosaurina' is a calque; Spanish uses the formal name or the plural noun.
findings.correct: Daspletosaurus y Tarbosaurus son otros miembros de la subfamilia Tyrannosaurinae (tiranosaurinos) y en ocasiones se han considerado sinónimos de Tyrannosaurus.

findings.en_sentence: The juvenile skeleton 'Jane' was initially debated as either a pygmy tyrannosaurid or a juvenile T. rex, but is now re-described as the holotype of Nanotyrannus lethaeus.
findings.es_sentence: El esqueleto juvenil 'Jane' fue inicialmente debatido como un tiranosáurido enano o un juvenil de T. rex, pero ahora se redescribe como el holotipo de Nanotyrannus lethaeus.
findings.problem: 'fue inicialmente debatido como' is a calque; 'ahora se redescribe' wrong tense.
findings.correct: Inicialmente se debatió si el esqueleto juvenil 'Jane' era un tiranosáurido enano o un T. rex juvenil, pero se ha redescrito como el holotipo de Nanotyrannus lethaeus.
